The paragraph [Anne Arundel County, Maryland] explicitly states, "The county is named for Lady Anne Arundell (1615–1649), a member of the ancient family of Arundells in Cornwall, England and the wife of Cecilius Calvert, 2nd Baron Baltimore (1605–1675), founder and first Lord Proprietor of the colony Province of Maryland."

Final answer: Anne Arundel County
